explanation: erdosproblems.com/89: Guth and Katz [GuKa15] proved that every set of n points in ℝ² determines ≫ n/log n distinct distances. The Lean statement: n/log n = O(minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² n) as n → ∞, where minimalDistinctDistances is the sInf over n-point sets of the number of distinct pairwise distances (FormalConjecturesForMathlib Geometry/Metric). This is exactly the ≫ lower bound for the worst configuration. Faithful.
